This file is for doing data import. 


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

## Import two datasets
Import our first dataset

```{r}
litters_df = 
  read_csv(file = "data/FAS_litters.csv",  
           na = c(".", "NA","")
           )

# read_csv is tidyverse updated and better while read.csv is base R

litters_df = janitor::clean_names(litters_df)
```

Import our second dataset
```{r}
pups_df =
  read_csv(file = "data/FAS_pups.csv", 
           skip = 3, # skip 3 rows because the csv has the data codebook on the first few rows
           na = c(".", "NA","") # character vector of strings to interpret as missing values
           ) 
pups_df = janitor::clean_names(pups_df)
```

## Look at the data
```{r}
# litters_df
# pups_df
```

Head or tail
```{r}
head(litters_df, 20)
tail(pups_df, 5)
```

Skimming??

```{r}
skimr::skim(pups_df) # prints an extended summary of what's going on (new function!!)
```
